articles.body: Qwen Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent that lets you switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen APIs, and local models (Ollama, vLLM) without rewriting tool definitions or restarting the session. It ships with Auto-Memory, Auto-Skills, SubAgents, Agent Teams, and MCP support. The project has 28.8K stars and is trending #9 on GitHub for TypeScript. The team uses the agent to file issues, submit PRs, and review code on its own repository. The interesting plumbing is how it maintains state and context when you swap providers mid-conversation, and how the same tool definitions work across OpenAI function calling, Anthropic tool use, and local model APIs that may not support structured outputs.

articles.excerpt: Why a CRM CSV export needs its own check Separate machine transfer from spreadsheet viewing before handing an export to a sales representative. User-entered fields can become formulas in the applicati…
articles.body: Why a CRM CSV export needs its own check Separate machine transfer from spreadsheet viewing before handing an export to a sales representative. User-entered fields can become formulas in the application that opens the file. Under an agreed policy, hold suspicious rows for review while retaining their original values in protected storage. Putting fields inside quotation marks does not establish that formulas are safe. OWASP describes CSV Injection as untrusted input entering a CSV and subsequently being interpreted by spreadsheet software. In particular, a cell beginning with = may be treated as a formula. CWE-1236 documents the weakness and the limitations of mitigation techniques.[1][2] A company name, an enquiry comment, or a field copied from another service can contain untrusted text.

articles.body: Почему CSV из CRM требует отдельной проверки Перед передачей выгрузки менеджеру разделите машинный обмен и просмотр в электронной таблице. Поля, введённые пользователем, могут оказаться формулами для программы, которая откроет файл. Подозрительные строки лучше задержать для разбора по согласованной политике, сохранив исходные значения в защищённом хранилище. Заключение полей в кавычки само по себе не делает формулы безопасными. OWASP описывает CSV Injection как попадание недоверенных данных в CSV с последующей интерпретацией содержимого электронной таблицей. В частности, ячейка, начинающаяся с = , может быть прочитана как формула.

articles.body: TL;DR what: China-nexus group Warp Panda exploited CVE-2026-41709, an insufficient logging flaw in Broadcom VMware ESX, as a zero-day in early 2026 to reduce audit trail visibility. impact: An actor with admin access can perform certain operations without being logged, which weakens the audit record for hosts in environments already targeted with BRICKSTORM and SharpStorm malware. fix: Broadcom's July 2026 advisory lists fixes for VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, ESX and Telco Cloud Platform, including ESXi80U3j-25429389 and Cloud Foundation 5.2.4. who: Organizations running affected VMware products are in scope, with U.S. legal sector firms named as targets and CrowdStrike reporting Warp Panda activity across multiple U.S. sectors.
